name: Grocery
headline: Neighborhood groceries, delivered
intro: Stock up on staples, snacks and household basics from trusted local grocers — without leaving home.
story: NearMart grocery is built around the shops you already trust. Compare prices across neighborhood kiranas, refill pantry staples, and get the same brands you buy in person — delivered the same day.

name: Fruits & Veggies
headline: Farm-fresh produce nearby
intro: Seasonal fruits and vegetables sourced from sellers around you, packed and delivered while they are still fresh.
story: This aisle is for shoppers who want produce that still looks like it came from the morning market. Sellers restock throughout the day, so tomatoes, greens and fruit stay closer to harvest.

name: Dairy & Bakery
headline: Fresh dairy and bakery
intro: Milk, butter, bread and bakery favorites from nearby shops that restock throughout the day.
story: Chilled dairy and oven-fresh bread are treated as time-sensitive. NearMart partners with shops that restock early, so milk, butter and bakery items arrive closer to when they were packed.

name: Beverages
headline: Drinks from shops around you
intro: Tea, coffee, juices and cold drinks from neighborhood stores, ready for quick delivery.
story: From morning chai supplies to cold juices, this collection pulls beverages from kiranas and specialty shops nearby so you are not waiting on a warehouse miles away.

name: Fashion
headline: Local fashion, delivered fast
intro: Clothing, footwear and accessories from boutiques and stores in your city — styled locally, delivered to your door.
story: Fashion on NearMart is not a generic catalog. It is the inventory sitting in boutiques and multi-brand stores around you — sneakers, denim, basics — with sizes you can actually try later in-store.

name: Electronics
headline: Gadgets from trusted nearby sellers
intro: Phones, audio, cables and accessories from electronics shops you can actually visit in your neighborhood.
story: Buy cables, audio and phone accessories from the same electronics counters people in your area already use. If something needs a swap, the seller is close enough to make it simple.

name: Pharmacy
headline: Wellness from local pharmacies
intro: Everyday health, wellness and personal care products from pharmacies close to you.
story: Skip the last-minute chemist run. NearMart pharmacy listings come from local health stores so everyday wellness, personal care and first-aid items stay in stock nearby.

name: Beauty
headline: Beauty from stores next door
intro: Skincare, makeup and personal care from local beauty counters and health stores.
story: Beauty on NearMart is curated from nearby counters — serums, gels, masks and everyday personal care — so you can restock favorites without a mall trip.
